cause: The bounded coefficient reader exposed coefficient statistics but omitted persisted outcome, panel identifiers, degrees of freedom, and cluster metadata. The Agent consequently inferred unavailable specification facts and overinterpreted a covariance comparison.
impact: A user-facing model comparison could contain unsupported inference even though the Workbench had already persisted the necessary non-row metadata.
lesson: Project model specification and inference metadata through the same bounded evidence reader as coefficients, and explicitly prohibit diagnostic or causal claims that a covariance comparison alone cannot establish.

evidence.ref: CE5 Agent transcript plus 178 focused agent/workflow/panel tests
